segments.name: In Vitro Diagnostic Products
segments.description: Development and commercialization of in vitro diagnostic products for clinical and consumer use across multiple healthcare segments.
segments.evidence: In our current portfolio, we feature six In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) platforms: Chemiluminescence Immunoassay (ChLIA), Lateral Flow Immunoassay (LFIA), Fluorescent Immunoassay (FIA), Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Loop-mediated Isothermal Amplification (LAMP), and Dry Chemistry.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase in vitro diagnostic products and tests for clinical, professional, and consumer use in healthcare settings globally.
revenueModel.evidence: Since 2023, we have commenced sales of our non-COVID products in countries within the European Union (EU), Americas, APAC, and Africa.
